sections.heading: You Decide the Trade
sections.body: Engineering, Business, Hospitality & Hotel Management, Technology & ICT, Agriculture, or Nursery Teaching & Early Childhood Education — browse the full catalog and pick the course that fits where you want to go.

sections.heading: Admission Runs Year-Round
sections.body: There's no single intake date to wait for. Junior Certificate entry needs P7 (PLE); National Certificate needs S4 (UCE); short courses and professional certificates are open to everyone.

sections.heading: Take the Step
sections.body: Apply online, or contact the Institute directly to speak with admissions before you commit.
